title: TikTok
description: TikTok is instantly recognizable by its bold brand palette: a deep black (#010101) base paired with a vibrant cyan (#25f4ee) and a bright red-pink (#fe2c55), accented with white (#ffffff). This striking combination, echoing its musical-note logomark's chromatic-aberration effect, is central to TikTok's youthful, energetic identity.
